part_4_finding_W5.title: The scheduler loads worktree bytes, so the P4.1 observation window ran partly on uncommitted code
facts: the venv installs alphapilot as an editable package whose path file points at the repository src directory, so the scheduler executes worktree bytes, not an immutable installed copy
src/alphapilot/jobs/registry.py, the common execution wrapper for every job including news_poll, was modified in the worktree at 2026-08-13 14:51 CST and remains uncommitted
the scheduler process that has served the window since 2026-08-13 18:26 CST started after that edit, so it loaded the modified wrapper
the change replaces a finally-block baostock session close with a baostock_session_scope context manager around every job body
part_4_finding_W5.correction_to_W3: the reviewer's earlier W-3 note claimed the respawned scheduler was verified to be running post-merge code. That verification was insufficient: it confirmed the launchd program and working directory pointed at the repository, not that the worktree bytes equalled the merged commit. The claim is corrected here rather than restated.

impact_assessment.misfire_remediation_intact: the reviewed misfire_grace_time field and its positive-integer validation are present in the worktree registry.py, so the 600-second grace remained in force
impact_assessment.runtime_effect_on_news_poll: effectively nil. baostock_session_scope sets a ContextVar marker and, for a job that never touches baostock, does nothing on exit; its lock acquisition is non-blocking. news_poll pays one ContextVar set and reset per run, with no network, no blocking lock and no new failure mode
impact_assessment.window_evidence_still_readable: slot completeness and data integrity are behavioural observations and remain valid, but the window's code-provenance premise is no longer clean and must be disclosed in the 2026-08-18 verdict rather than quietly assumed
impact_assessment.homogeneity: day one changed wrapper mid-day at 18:26 CST; days two and three run entirely under the post-respawn code provided the scheduler is not restarted again

part_4_finding_W5.standing_rule_proposed: for any future acceptance window, pin provenance explicitly: record at window start, and re-verify at any restart, that every worktree file the scheduler imports equals the intended commit. An editable install makes an uncommitted edit indistinguishable from deployed code unless this is checked.
